baseline.caveat: Semrush snapshot of 29 Sep, kept as the starting point. From 5 Oct the tracked terms are measured directly in Swiss Google and the AI engines via DataForSEO; see the two tables below.

ai.summary: Measured 5 Oct via the ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity APIs on the 20 tracked prompts (full table further down). Meditron owns the direct question in every language. The gaps are price, model comparison and the brand-less German and Italian practice questions.

tiers.name: Tier 1 · generic, no brand, no country
examples: best ultrasound machine for a gynaecology practice
échographe pour cabinet médical, lequel choisir
ecografo per studio medico, quale scegliere
tiers.result: Closest tracked prompts (no brand, Switzerland named): Meditron named in 7 of 12 answers, site cited in 5. Named in EN and FR, absent in DE and IT where Lysis, MHZ and SMD Medical are named instead.

tiers.name: Tier 2 · brand, no country
tiers.result: Model and price prompts: Meditron named in 0 of 24 answers, site cited in 1. Nobody answers the price question with a Swiss source; the model comparison names Lysis. Articles 2, 4 and 5 target exactly these.

tiers.name: Tier 3 · brand + Switzerland (core targets)
tiers.result: Core prompts: Meditron named in 12 of 12 answers, site cited in 8. Meditron is named first in all four languages on all three engines.

tiers.name: Tier 4 · “official distributor” wording
tiers.result: No prompt in the tracking list uses the 'official distributor' wording. The core answers already call Meditron the official distributor; four prompts can be added next week.

tiers.name: Tier 5 · service, used, leasing
tiers.result: New-or-used prompts: Meditron named in 1 of 12 answers, site cited in 1. Only ChatGPT in German names Meditron (citing article 3). French and Italian answers name MHZ.

tiers.name: Tier 6 · Meditron named
examples: Is Meditron the official Samsung ultrasound distributor in Switzerland?
tiers.result: Prompts that name Meditron are the easiest case and were left out of the list to save budget. Add two if you want them on the page.

timeline.text: Programme plan agreed. German confirmed as master language; English stays the default locale.
Technical audit of the new Framer site: broken German title, no H1s, no structured data, /old-home indexed.
Live: 53 redirects from old URLs, sitemap with 238 pages per language, Search Console verified, hub page intro and FAQ in EN and DE.
H1 headings site-wide. Structured data (Organization, two LocalBusiness, Product, Breadcrumb, Article). Titles and descriptions in four languages. Alt text on 219 product images.
Semrush baseline taken. Six articles drafted in English and German. Article template: contents list, FAQ accordion, author byline.

Articles 1–3 published. “Latest” renamed to “Insights” in the navigation and footer. Home section renamed “News and Insights”. Article images standardised at 3:2 with the Meditron mark on brand colours.
German and French article URLs now carry German and French slugs (e.g. /de/news-events/ultraschallgeraet-neu-oder-occasion). Old URLs redirect. Publish dates staggered across September.
Articles 4 to 6 on staging in EN, DE and FR with images and FAQ. Tracking list of 24 Google terms and 20 AI prompts agreed. Article tables fixed for narrow screens.
DataForSEO connected. First direct measurement of the 24 tracked Swiss searches and 20 AI prompts across ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity. Tables added to this report.

discuss.why: The hub and model pages now carry 'Samsung Ultraschall' in the headline. The home page and About page headlines are brand phrases ('Auf Erfahrung gebaut'). Do we want the home headline to say what Meditron is, in one line, for Google and AI assistants?
The 'Our why' paragraph animates letter by letter. Browser translation, screen readers and AI readers get scrambled text. Keep the animation or switch to plain text?
Italian pages show the English text today. Translate the six articles, or hide Italian for Insights until there is a reviewer?
'Ultraschallgerät Occasion' is one of the strongest buying searches. A live list of certified pre-owned systems would rank for it. Is there stock to show, and who keeps it current?
The price article ranks without numbers. Competitors publish none either. Would Meditron publish 'from CHF' ranges per class, or stay with quote only?
A link from Samsung Healthcare's own 'where to buy' page is the single strongest backlink available. Is Meditron listed with a link, and who at Samsung can confirm it?
Rolle and Frauenfeld profiles with 'Samsung Ultraschall' in the description feed the map results and AI answers. Who owns the Google account?
Eight older news items have English URLs and no German or French text. Translate, leave, or archive?
The Events tab is hidden. Congress and trade-fair pages earn links and local searches. Any 2026 or 2027 dates to list?
Articles use brand-colour placeholders with the Meditron mark. Product or practice photography would lift click-through from Google and LinkedIn. Is there a photo library?
The home page is 1.4 MB of HTML with 194 images, heavy for phones and crawlers. Worth a design pass to trim sections?
